name: cope-b-a4b-mm
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA + sliding-window/global hybrid with separate global head geometry (global_head_dim 512, num_global_key_value_heads 2)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-24. A finetune of google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, not a new base model: same config.json, same 25.806 parameters .
